overloads.semanticRole: Returns the visible position (1-based, relative to the top item of the main list, accounting for the current expanded/collapsed state) of the item whose reference number is itemRef within the hierarchical list identified by list; returns 0 if the item does not exist.

discriminatedBy.rule: If * is passed, list is the object name (Text) of a form representation of the list; if omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number (Integer).
